case_text: A 68-year-old man with a long smoking history presents with painless gross hematuria. CT urography reveals a mass in the bladder wall.

profile.suspected_diagnosis: Bladder cancer (urothelial/transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder)
labs: CT urography reveals a mass in the bladder wall

criteria.text: Able to understand and willing to sign a written informed consent document
A papillary tumor identified by cystoscopy that has been scheduled for TURBT OR histologically proven MIBC that is clinically localized and amenable to surgical resection with curative intent.

Normal renal function as defined as creatinine less than 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) OR creatinine clearance greater than or equal to 50 mL/min/1.73 m2 by Cockcroft-Gault formula for subjects with creatinine levels greater than or equal to 1.5 x ULN.
Severe hypersensitivity reaction to gadobutrol or ferumoxytol.
Severe claustrophobia that will prevent completion of the MRI study.
Any MRI-non-compatible implanted device, prosthetic or pacemaker.
Women with active pregnancy, lactation or plans to conceive
Known urethral stricture disease that would prohibit placement of foley catheter.
Any other conditions considered as unacceptable risk by the treating physician

judgments.evidence: 환자 나이 68세, 기준 18세 이상 ~ 90세 이하 → 해당 (코드 판정)
Ability and willingness to understand and sign informed consent can only be determined at enrollment.
Q1 answer: "내시경이나 조직검사는 아직 안 받았고, 큰 병원 예약만 해둔 상태예요." No cystoscopy, no TURBT scheduled yet, and no histologic diagnosis. A bladder mass on CT only; the appointment may lead to cystoscopy/TURBT.
sub_condition_notes: Papillary tumor by cystoscopy scheduled for TURBT: not yet — no cystoscopy done, TURBT not scheduled (unknown whether it will be).
Histologically proven MIBC: no biopsy done, so not currently met; could become met after workup.

judgments.evidence: Q9 answer: "네, 거동에 문제 없고 혼자 생활할 수 있어요." This suggests good function but does not formally establish ECOG 0 or 1 (ability to do light work, no daytime bed rest not explicitly stated).
Q10 answer: "최근 1년 안에는 피검사를 안 해봐서 결과지가 없어요." No creatinine value available.
Q8 answer: "잘 모르겠어요. 그런 주사 맞고 문제 생긴 기억은 없어요." Patient is unsure and has no recalled reaction; no confirmed exposure.
Q7 answer: "그런 검사를 받아본 적이 없어서 잘 모르겠어요." Never had an MRI-type scan; claustrophobia status unknown.
Q6 answer: "잘 모르겠어요. 따로 들은 적은 없어요." Patient is unsure about implanted devices.
Only a bladder wall mass on CT urography is described; no information on staging or metastasis is given. Staging workup is not complete.
환자가 남성라 임신·수유 기준에 해당하지 않음 (코드 판정)
No urinalysis or urine culture/UTI information is provided; hematuria alone does not establish a UTI.
No mention of urethral stricture disease.
Depends on the treating physician's judgment of unacceptable risk.

criteria.text: Occupation:≥ 15 years of occupational exposures including: textile worker, painter, dry cleaners
Prior history of bladder, kidney, or prostate cancer
Prior evaluation of micro or gross hematuria within the last 2 years

judgments.evidence: 환자 나이 68세, 기준 50세 이상 → 해당 (코드 판정)
Q2 answer: "하루에 한 갑 정도씩 45년 동안 피웠고, 지금도 피우고 있어요." (about 1 pack/day × 45 years = ~45 pack-years, which is ≥15).

Q3 answer: "그건 잘 모르겠어요, 따로 말씀드릴 만한 기억이 없어요." The patient is unsure, and no occupational exposure or duration is documented. This criterion may be an either/or alternative to I2, but that is not stated, so it stays unknown.
Q4 answer: "암 진단을 받은 적은 없고 치료받은 적도 없어요. 이번에 방광에 혹이 있다는 말만 들었어요." The patient reports no prior bladder, kidney, or prostate cancer.

Q5 answer: "3주 전부터 소변에 피가 섞여 나와서 동네 병원에서 CT를 찍었어요." The hematuria began 3 weeks ago, and the CT was done for the current episode. There is no mention of any earlier evaluation for hematuria within the last 2 years. Whether the current workup counts as a "prior" evaluation is for the study team to decide.
sub_condition_notes: Micro or gross hematuria evaluation in the last 2 years: no earlier evaluation reported. The only workup described is the current CT for this 3-week episode.

judgments.evidence: Informed consent is given at enrollment and cannot be determined beforehand.

questions.text: 방광내시경 검사에서 방광 안에 종양이 보인다는 말을 들으셨거나, 방광 종양 제거 수술(경요도 방광종양절제술)이 예정되어 있나요? 방광 종양 조직검사 결과를 들으셨다면 함께 알려 주세요.

questions.text: 지금까지 담배를 하루에 대략 몇 갑씩, 몇 년 동안 피우셨나요?
섬유(옷감) 관련 일, 페인트 작업, 드라이클리닝 업소에서 일하신 적이 있나요? 있다면 모두 합쳐 몇 년 정도 일하셨는지 알려 주세요.

answers.answer: 동네 병원에서 CT를 찍었더니 방광에 혹이 있다고 들었어요. 내시경이나 조직검사는 아직 안 받았고, 큰 병원 예약만 해둔 상태예요.
하루에 한 갑 정도씩 45년 동안 피웠고, 지금도 피우고 있어요.
그건 잘 모르겠어요, 따로 말씀드릴 만한 기억이 없어요.

questions.needed_info: 가돌리늄 계열 MRI 조영제(가도부트롤)나 페루목시톨(철분 주사) 과민반응 경험
